TestCase.name: testAsyncCalc
TestCase.Resource: SELECT func1(a) FROM MyTable
LogicalProject(EXPR$0=[func1($0)]) +- LogicalTableScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, MyTable]])
AsyncCalc(select=[func1(a) AS EXPR$0]) +- TableSourceScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, MyTable]], fields=[a, b, c])

TestCase.name: testAsyncCalcInFilterIsSplit
TestCase.Resource: SELECT a FROM MyTable WHERE func1(a) > 0
LogicalProject(a=[$0]) +- LogicalFilter(condition=[>(func1($0), 0)]) +- LogicalTableScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, MyTable]])
Calc(select=[a], where=[(f0 > 0)]) +- AsyncCalc(select=[a, func1(a) AS f0]) +- TableSourceScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, MyTable]], fields=[a, b, c])

TestCase.name: testAsyncCalcIsNotMergedIntoMultipleInput
TestCase.Resource: SELECT t1.a, t1.f, t2.b FROM (SELECT a, func1(a) AS f FROM (SELECT a FROM MyTable GROUP BY a)) t1 JOIN MyTable2 t2 ON t1.a = t2.a

LogicalProject(a=[$0], f=[$1], b=[$3]) +- LogicalJoin(condition=[=($0, $2)], joinType=[inner]) :- LogicalProject(a=[$0], f=[func1($0)]) : +- LogicalAggregate(group=[{0}]) : +- LogicalProject(a=[$0]) : +- LogicalTableScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, MyTable]]) +- LogicalTableScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, MyTable2]])

Calc(select=[a, f, b]) +- HashJoin(joinType=[InnerJoin], where=[(a = a0)], select=[a, f, a0, b], build=[left]) :- Exchange(distribution=[keep_input_as_is[hash[a]]]) : +- AsyncCalc(select=[a, func1(a) AS f]) : +- Exchange(distribution=[keep_input_as_is[hash[a]]]) : +- HashAggregate(isMerge=[true], groupBy=[a], select=[a]) : +- Exchange(distribution=[hash[a]]) : +- LocalHashAggregate(groupBy=[a], select=[a]) : +- Calc(select=[a]) : +- TableSourceScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, MyTable]], fields=[a, b, c]) +- Exchange(distribution=[hash[a]]) +- Calc(select=[a, b]) +- TableSourceScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, MyTable2]], fields=[a, b, c])

TestCase.name: testAsyncCalcNextToJoin
TestCase.Resource: SELECT func1(t1.a), t2.b FROM MyTable t1 JOIN MyTable2 t2 ON t1.a = t2.a

LogicalProject(EXPR$0=[func1($0)], b=[$4]) +- LogicalJoin(condition=[=($0, $3)], joinType=[inner]) :- LogicalTableScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, MyTable]]) +- LogicalTableScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, MyTable2]])

Calc(select=[f0 AS EXPR$0, b]) +- AsyncCalc(select=[b, func1(a) AS f0]) +- HashJoin(joinType=[InnerJoin], where=[(a = a0)], select=[a, a0, b], build=[left]) :- Exchange(distribution=[hash[a]]) : +- Calc(select=[a]) : +- TableSourceScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, MyTable]], fields=[a, b, c]) +- Exchange(distribution=[hash[a]]) +- Calc(select=[a, b]) +- TableSourceScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, MyTable2]], fields=[a, b, c])

TestCase.name: testAsyncCallInCorrelateArgument
TestCase.Resource: SELECT * FROM MyTable, LATERAL TABLE(tableFunc(func1(a)))

LogicalProject(a=[$0], b=[$1], c=[$2], EXPR$0=[$3]) +- LogicalCorrelate(correlation=[$cor0], joinType=[inner], requiredColumns=[{0}]) :- LogicalTableScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, MyTable]]) +- LogicalTableFunctionScan(invocation=[tableFunc(func1($cor0.a))], rowType=[RecordType(VARCHAR(2147483647) EXPR$0)])

Calc(select=[a, b, c, EXPR$0]) +- Correlate(invocation=[tableFunc($3)], correlate=[table(tableFunc(f0))], select=[a,b,c,f0,EXPR$0], rowType=[RecordType(INTEGER a, BIGINT b, VARCHAR(2147483647) c, INTEGER f0, VARCHAR(2147483647) EXPR$0)], joinType=[INNER]) +- AsyncCalc(select=[a, b, c, func1(a) AS f0]) +- TableSourceScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, MyTable]], fields=[a, b, c])
